name: GIRDER 格拉德 Dash 105 Di2 — documented 2023 build
why_interesting: Several early-2023 dealer posts document a DASH 105 Di2 with an all-carbon cockpit and wheels at a claimed CNY 17,800 and a dealer-reported 8.39 kg, a build that no current official DASH page lists.

facts.brakes: Shimano 105 hydraulic disc (one listing names the 105 Di2 hydraulic-disc group)
facts.frame: DASH carbon frame and fork; generation and shell not identified
facts.frame_material: Carbon frame, fork and seatpost per the listing; fiber grade and lay-up not stated
facts.stiffness_evidence: No measured or comparative stiffness evidence found
facts.wheels: Carbon wheels with ceramic bearings (as listed); depth not stated for this listing
facts.complete_weight_basis: Dealer-reported weight for this R7170 build (2023-03-06); a 2023-02-19 retailer post repeats 8.39 kg as weighed for an electronic 2×12 DASH. Size, pedals and weighing method are not stated, and the two posts may not be independent.
facts.marketplace_labels: 帝狮 and 帝师 are observed marketplace transliterations, not evidence of a separate model.
facts.year_note: The year in the name is the date of the source posts, not an established manufacturer model year.

alternative_builds.label: DASH 105 Di2 listing with 45/65 mm wheels (2023-02-20)
alternative_builds.wheels: Carbon wheels, 45 mm front / 65 mm rear, ceramic hubs
alternative_builds.tires: Schwalbe tires (model and width not stated)
alternative_builds.notes: Package-specific dealer listing. Its wheels are not assumed for the reference row, and the 8.39 kg claim from other posts is not attached to it.

observed_price.price_basis: Dealer-claimed official price on a 2023 XHS post, with better offers invited in private. Not verified against a 2023 manufacturer page; historical reference, not a current offer or checkout.

missing: Size, pedal and weighing basis of the 8.39 kg claim
Frame generation, geometry and bottom-bracket shell standard
Independent exact-model stiffness or deflection measurement
Current new-bike availability, exact-build price, purchase route and warranty terms
source_note: The reference row follows the explicitly R7170 dealer post of 2023-03-06. The 8.39 kg figure is a dealer report; it is not a weight for the official NEW 2025 DASH or ROAD endurance DASH builds. A 2023-02-20 listing with 45/65 mm wheels stays a separate documented package.
price_status: Historical dealer-claimed CNY 17,800 on 2023-03-06; no current price or checkout verified
